flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: Only scaffolding in ocmsadminui: utils/Meta/System.ts (path/title), utils/mapping/SystemAdmin.ts (COMPLAINANT_CODE mapping), utils/validation/Format/ValidFile.ts (file rules), utils/models/{Fsystemadmin,Fapi,Icourtcase,Icsdbatch}.d.ts (types). No route, page, menu, controller, entity or cron. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no complainant code.
note: The story asks that a Court Processing Officer can create/amend complainant codes and names that are then interfaced to State Courts. The code does not have this feature: there is no route, menu, list or form in the staff portal, and no entity/endpoint/job in the four backends. Only placeholders exist in ocmsadminui (path '/system/complainant-code', menu title, types) that are wired to no route or menu, so no behaviour can be claimed. No maintenance ticket mentions complainant. The 'Fully paid' status is not supported by code in the repos; it may have been built outside these six repos (cannot verify from repo).
recommendation: Do not claim as done based on code. Ask URA/the team in which repo the complainant maintenance was built, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: Officer opens the Complainant Code maintenance screen in the staff portal
steps.detail: The System Admin menu only has Parameter, Standard Code, Suspension Reason, Offence Rule Code, Schedule Public Holiday (ocmsadminui/src/utils/data/LinkData.tsx:70-109); the /system routes in App.tsx only cover parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason, schedule-public-holiday (ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx:375-500). There is no route, menu, list or form for complainant. Only behaviourless scaffolding exists: a path constant '/system/complainant-code' (System.ts:10, 44) and the title 'Complainant Code' (System.ts:115-118), which no route, menu or page uses.

steps.step: Officer creates a new complainant code together with the complainant name
steps.detail: There is no create form for complainant. The pages/System folder only holds the Parameter, RuleCode, SchedulePublicHoliday, StandardCode, SuspensionReason forms (ocmsadminui/src/pages/System/form/). The CREATE meta for COMPLAINANT_CODE is generated from the key list (System.ts:115-118) but no component uses it. No entity, repository, controller or SQL named complainant / signature / oic_signature exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep over src, 0 relevant hits; the stale ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice copy was ignored).

steps.step: Officer amends an existing complainant code or complainant name
steps.detail: There is no list or EDIT form for complainant (the edit path is only generated from the key in System.ts, with no component). No entity, repository, controller or SQL named complainant / signature / oic_signature exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep over src, 0 relevant hits; the stale ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice copy was ignored).

steps.step: The complainant code and name changes are saved in the OCMS database
steps.detail: Fapi.d.ts:210 only lists the resource name 'complainantsignature' as a string type; nothing calls it. No entity, repository, controller or SQL named complainant / signature / oic_signature exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep over src, 0 relevant hits; the stale ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice copy was ignored). The complainant table name in the DB cannot be confirmed: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The complainant code and name are interfaced to State Courts
steps.detail: Icsdbatch.d.ts:8 and Icourtcase.d.ts:8 are only TypeScript types with a complainant_code field; no code fills or sends it. No job, SFTP or API to State Courts carries complainant data in any backend (grep 0 hits). The State Courts side and SFTP partner: cannot verify from repo.
